problems.title: Factorial
problems.statement: Read n (0 to 20) from stdin and print n factorial.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Stored the factorial in an int, which overflows from 13! on.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop stops before multiplying by n.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: Forgot to start the product at 1.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Added instead of multiplied.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Started multiplying from 3 and skipped the factor 2.

problems.title: Sum of squares
problems.statement: Read n (0 to 1000000) and print 1*1 + 2*2 + ... + n*n.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: The running total is an int and passes 2 billion.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: sum is never set to 0 before adding.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Last square n*n is left out.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Used i*2 instead of i*i.

problems.title: Fibonacci number
problems.statement: Read n (0 to 90) and print the n-th Fibonacci number with F(0)=0 and F(1)=1.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Fibonacci values were kept in int and wrap after F(46).

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: a was never given the starting value 0.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Loop runs one step too few.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop runs one step too many and prints F(n+1).

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Multiplied the last two numbers instead of adding.

problems.title: GCD, LCM and steps
problems.statement: Read two positive integers a and b (each at most 2000000000). Print their gcd, their lcm and the number of division steps Euclid's algorithm took, separated by spaces.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: The lcm product is computed in int before it is stored in a long long.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: Step counter not initialised.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop continues when y is 0 and divides by zero.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: lcm computed as a*b, forgetting to divide by the gcd.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Step counter starts at 1.

problems.title: Digit sum and digit count
problems.statement: Read a non-negative integer n (up to 10^18) and print the sum of its digits and how many digits it has, separated by a space.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: n read into an int cannot hold values above 2147483647.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: sum is not set to 0 before the loop.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Forgot that the number 0 has one digit.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop never ends because n stays 0.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Digit counter starts at 1 and over counts.

problems.title: Min max average
problems.statement: Read n (1 or more) and then n integers (each between -2147483648 and 2147483647). Print the minimum, the maximum and the average with 2 decimals, separated by spaces.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: The sum of the numbers is stored in an int.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: min and max never given starting values.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Integer division loses the decimals of the average.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: Compared the new value with the max instead of the min.

problems.title: Product and big count
problems.statement: Read n (1 to 9) and then n integers between 1 and 100. Print their product and how many of them are at least 50, separated by a space. The product always fits in 64 bits.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: The product is kept in an int.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: prod is not started at 1.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: Value exactly 50 is not counted.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Summed instead of multiplying.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Reads one more number than given.

problems.title: Binomial coefficient
problems.statement: Read n and k (0 <= k <= n <= 60). Print C(n, k), the number of ways to choose k items from n.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: The running binomial is an int.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Last factor is skipped.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Numerator factor is off by one.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: res is not started at 1.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Divides before multiplying, so integer division truncates.

problems.title: Box surface and volume
problems.statement: Read the length, width and height of a box (each 1 to 1000000). Print its volume, its surface area and the area of its smallest face, separated by spaces.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Dimensions stored in int so the volume overflows.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: Minimum has no starting value.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Surface formula misses one pair of faces.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Skips the first face when looking for the smallest.

problems.title: Collatz steps and peak
problems.statement: Read n (1 to 1000000000). Repeat: if n is even halve it, otherwise replace it by 3n+1, until it reaches 1. Print the number of steps and the largest value reached, separated by a space.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: 3n+1 passes 2^31 for some starts but x is an int.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: steps not initialised.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop never stops once x reaches 1.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Peak should start at the starting value, which may itself be the peak.

problems.title: Modular power
problems.statement: Read a, b and m (0 <= a <= 1000000000, 0 <= b <= 1000000000, 1 <= m <= 1000000000). Print a to the power b modulo m.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Products of two residues overflow int.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: Result not given a starting value.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Missed the case m = 1, where the answer is 0.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop never ends since b stays at 0.

problems.title: Multiples of 3 or 5
problems.statement: Read n (1 to 10000000). Print the sum of all positive integers below n that are divisible by 3 or by 5.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Total stored in an int.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: n itself is included when divisible.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: Used && where || was meant.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: sum is not zero at the start.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Counted the numbers instead of adding them.

problems.title: Best contiguous sum
problems.statement: Read n (1 to 100000) and then n integers with absolute value at most 2000000000. Print the largest sum of any non-empty run of consecutive numbers.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Running sums held in int.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Loop restarts at 0 and counts a[0] twice.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: best has no starting value.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Best starts at 0, wrong when all numbers are negative.

problems.title: Sum of non multiples
problems.statement: Read n and k (1 <= k <= n <= 2000000000). Print the sum 1+2+...+n, how many numbers from 1 to n are multiples of k, the sum of the numbers that are not multiples of k, and the number of digits of n, separated by spaces.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: n*(n+1) is computed in int before widening.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Wrong formula for the sum 1..n.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Number of multiples is off by one when n is a multiple of k.

bugs.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
bugs.note: Digit counter not initialised.
